ثَمْرَآءُ : see ثَمَرٌ, first sentence. ＝
-A2- شَجَرَةٌ ثَمْرَآءُ A tree having fruit; (S;) of which the fruit has come forth: (K:) or abounding with fruit; as also ↓ ثَمِيرَةٌ : or this latter signifies the same as ↓ مُثْمِرَةٌ ; and its pl. is ثُمُرٌ. (AHn, M.) And أَرْضٌ ثَمْرَآءُ Land abounding with fruit; as also ↓ ثَمِيرَةٌ , (AHn, M, K,) or ↓ ثَمِرَةٌ . (So in some copies of the K, and in the TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
